description.value: Greek On the Street is a family-owned Victoria operation that grew from a roving food truck into a permanent Greek eatery at 492 Bay Street. The menu centres on classic dishes like chicken souvlaki, lemon potatoes, and vegetarian plates, with the food truck still operating at markets and events around Victoria. The business also runs a full catering arm (Estia Gourmet) serving weddings, corporate events, and film sets across Vancouver Island.
